visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a cream puffer jacket over a brown and white striped sweater, stands outdoors in front of the red-and-white Tokyo Tower. He performs two quick poses: one with hands above his head and another with a finger gun gesture. (2) He looks at the camera, gestures with his hands, and then crosses his arms while a red 'X' graphic overlay appears. He then points both thumbs toward the background. (3) He walks down a sidewalk alongside a city street. A 'Coca-Cola' parking sign is visible. The Tokyo Tower is seen in the distance between buildings. (4) He stops at a wooden fence and points to a sign with a camera icon, indicating a designated photography spot. (5) A map graphic appears briefly, showing a location near the tower. He approaches a metal 'CAMERA STAND' fixture. (6) Close-up of his hands placing a smartphone upside down onto the metal stand's slot. (7) He points to white footprint icons painted on a wooden bench, indicating where the subject should stand. (8) He stands on the bench, framing a perfect shot of the Tokyo Tower behind him. He poses with one arm raised and then points to a yellow save icon graphic.

(7) [Slogan]: 這裡竟然有個拍照點！. (8) [Logo]: イグニス エ. (9) [Slogan]: 這裡. (10) [Slogan]: 把相機放在這. (11) [Slogan]: 手機要倒著放. (12) [Slogan]: 站上長椅的話. (13) [Slogan]: 就像這樣！. (14) [Slogan]: 保存起來別忘囉！

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male character; approximately 3 distant passers-by blurred in the background of the park area.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with black hair, wearing a white/cream-colored puffer jacket, a brown, white, and dark blue horizontal striped sweater, blue jeans, and white sneakers.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The primary background is the Tokyo Tower, a red and white lattice communications and observation tower. Other backgrounds include a white modern building, a street with a Coca-Cola sign, a wooden fence, and a park-like area with benches and a specialized camera stand.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-tempo, upbeat 8-bit synthesizer melody. A crisp camera shutter SFX triggers immediately. (2) A second identical camera shutter SFX sounds as the visual changes to the second pose. (3) A third camera shutter SFX triggers. The BGM remains constant and energetic. (4) A low-pitched, dissonant electronic buzzer SFX plays, signaling a 'wrong' or 'negative' visual context. (5) A bright, high-pitched digital 'ding' SFX sounds as the protagonist points to the solution. (6) The BGM continues throughout the walking sequence. Occasional light digital UI chimes coincide with text appearing. (7) A sharp 'shutter' SFX sounds when the phone is placed on the stand. (8) A final, triumphant 'tada' synth chime plays for the photo reveal, followed by a final shutter click and a lingering synth note.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem -> Process -> Result -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide viewers with a practical travel tip for photographing the Tokyo Tower from a specific, high-quality viewpoint using a built-in camera stand and optimal phone placement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-contrast text and fast editing to maintain engagement. It specifically targets tourists visiting Tokyo seeking aesthetic social media content.
